record.notes: Version v1.0-202609, released on 15 Sept 2026 with notice 网安秘字〔2026〕118号 together with the general provisions and the education and audiovisual guides. The guide sets rules for dividing liability between doctors and AI when a system gives a wrong suggestion, and asks that systems be checked for performance across population subgroups; where performance drops markedly for groups such as children or the elderly, use in that group is to be restricted or the lower confidence clearly flagged. The informative annex grades AI applications in health as especially major, major, significant, general or low risk; the top grade has catastrophic and systemic features, and the annex refers to AI Safety Governance Framework 2.0 (CN-13) for grading. Normative references include GB/T 45654 (CN-10), GB 45438 (CN-08), GB/T 45674 (CN-24) and TC260-005, AI Application Ethics Security Guidelines 1.0. Drafting units include the National Health Commission's Statistical Information Center.

verification.note: Recheck of 18 Oct 2026. Read the guide's PDF from tc260.org.cn (version v1.0-202609; stored 14 Oct 2026, and identical when fetched again on 18 Oct 2026) and TC260's release notice 网安秘字〔2026〕118号 (tc260.org.cn, stored 18 Oct 2026 as the record's secondary source). The PDF confirms the title, the number TC260-PG-202610A, the TC260 Secretariat as issuer, the version and the contents; its cover gives only September 2026 (2026年09月), and the day, 15 Sept 2026, comes from the notice, which also lists this guide among the four it releases. The summary follows the Chinese text. No English version was found; the guide's statement reserves translation to the TC260 Secretariat's written authorisation.
